top_findings.title: app.py does not parse — 11 unterminated string literals
top_findings.evidence: python3 -m py_compile app.py -> SyntaxError: unterminated string literal at line 34; every jsonify() return is missing closing quote and paren. Module cannot be imported, so no endpoint runs.
top_findings.suggestion: Close each string and jsonify() call, e.g. return jsonify({"status": "healthy"}), 200

top_findings.title: Fewer than 3 tests and none exercise the API
top_findings.evidence: test_book_api.py:5 def test_book_api() only writes test_book_api.md; no import of app/test_client/requests. 1 non-testing function vs spec's >=3.
top_findings.suggestion: Write >=3 real tests using app.test_client() covering CRUD + validation.
